drills.notes: A lagging epoch narrows the shell claim to preview and recovers only after a fresh snapshot at the shared epoch.

steps.narration: The workspace tree lags the authoritative VFS epoch while another member of the group advances.
Epoch-parity evidence is observed stale: the surface trails the shared authoritative epoch.
The certified claim narrows to preview; the shell labels stale state rather than presenting a parallel epoch as truth.
The lagging consumer resubscribes and takes a fresh snapshot at the shared epoch.
Epoch-parity evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its stable maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current shell row.

drills.title: Shell narrows when it lags the shared authoritative epoch

drills.notes: Partial invalidation coverage narrows the search claim to beta without withholding it.

steps.narration: The recovery packet covers only part of the search invalidation reasons after an index producer restart.
Invalidation-behavior evidence is observed partial for the search profile.
The certified claim narrows to beta; search labels partial results and pairs them with a rerun path.
The invalidation evidence is completed across the remaining reasons.
Invalidation-behavior evidence returns current; the claim recovers to stable.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current search row.

drills.title: Search narrows to beta on partial invalidation coverage

drills.notes: Stale labeling evidence narrows the graph claim below beta even though it worked once on a happy-path capture.

steps.narration: The gated truth-cue evidence for the graph neighborhood ages past its freshness window.
Stale-state-labeling evidence is observed stale for the graph profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview until the labeling evidence is recaptured.
The gated truth-cue evidence is recaptured for the neighborhood.
Stale-state-labeling evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current graph row.

drills.title: Graph narrows to preview when stale-state labeling evidence ages out

drills.notes: A rolled policy epoch staled the safe-action evidence and narrowed the AI claim to preview until it was recaptured, never letting it imply exact current truth.

steps.narration: The policy epoch rolls, so the captured safe-action-narrowing evidence now trails the current entitlement.
Safe-action-narrowing evidence is observed stale for the AI profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview; the panel narrows to a policy-limited projection and gates affordances until the evidence is recaptured.
The safe-action evidence is recaptured against the new policy epoch.
Safe-action-narrowing evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current AI row.

drills.title: AI narrows to preview when a rolled policy epoch staled its safe-action evidence

drills.notes: Missing authority-class evidence withholds the review claim rather than leaving it green on a stale capture.

steps.narration: The governance evidence naming the review overlay's authority class is removed from the packet set.
Authority-class evidence is observed missing for the review profile.
The certification withholds the review claim; promotion fails until authority ownership is proven.
The governance authority-class evidence is restored for the review overlay.
Authority-class evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current review row.

drills.title: Review is withheld when authority-class evidence is missing

drills.notes: An unavailable capture provider narrows the support claim to preview and keeps the export honest about staleness.

steps.narration: The support capture provider is unavailable, so the invalidation-history evidence ages past its window.
Invalidation-behavior evidence is observed stale for the support export profile.
The exported claim narrows to preview; the support snapshot is labeled stale rather than live truth.
The provider returns and the invalidation-history capture is refreshed.
Invalidation-behavior evidence returns current; the exported claim recovers to beta.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current support row.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile with partial evidence on any required dimension narrows to at most a beta claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Partial reactive-state evidence proves only part of the claimed scope, so the profile may not present a stable reactive-state guarantee.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile with stale evidence on any required dimension narrows to at most a preview claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Stale reactive-state evidence may no longer reflect the current contract, so the profile drops below beta until the evidence is refreshed.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile missing evidence on any required dimension is withheld; promotion fails until the dimension is proven.
freshness_rules.rationale: A required reactive-state dimension with no backing evidence cannot be proven, so the profile may not be promoted at its claimed maturity.

invariants: Each claimed M5 reactive surface profile is certified only when every required dimension — authority class, epoch parity, invalidation behavior, stale-state labeling, and safe-action narrowing — is proven current.
One narrowing engine folds per-dimension evidence into a verdict: partial evidence narrows to beta, stale evidence narrows to preview, and missing evidence withholds the claim.
A stable or beta claim can never outrun its reactive-state evidence; the certification only narrows, never widens, and a profile absent from the packet is uncertified rather than implicitly green.
Release, support, docs, and help all read the same per-row verdict and narrowing tokens instead of re-deriving reactive-state staleness.
Failure and recovery drills exercise each profile through narrowing and back, computed from the same engine so the certification, drills, and fixtures cannot disagree.

dimensions.rationale: The governance matrix names the authority class and derivation that own this surface's truth; the subscription contract carries the same ownership in its envelope.
The surface shares an epoch-parity group with the other members of its authority class and reads one authoritative snapshot epoch instead of a private epoch.
The surface honors its invalidation reasons and recovers lagging consumers through coalesce, resubscribe, or fresh-snapshot flows without offering stale exact-truth actions.
Gated truth cues label warming, cached, stale, partial, and coalesced state, and the narrowing engine downgrades the claim identically across channels.
Mutating actions publish through the canonical command and journal path and narrow under degraded state instead of offering stale exact-truth affordances.

surface_bindings.summary: The shiproom dashboard reads the per-row verdict and effective maturity and holds promotion for any narrowed or withheld release-scope profile.
The metadata-first support export re-exports the per-row verdict, narrowing tokens, and stale-or-missing dimensions without raw payloads or ambient authority.
The reviewer documentation quotes the certified dimensions, freshness rules, and per-row verdicts directly from the packet.
The in-product reactive-state explainer reuses the same verdict vocabulary so help never tells a greener story than the packet.
